reasons: Prerequisites for CS2102 require CS2030S/CS2030/CS2030DE/CS2030HS AND (CS1231/MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231S) AND (CS2040S/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS). The student has completed CS2030S, CS1231S, and CS2040S, so CS2102 is eligible. However, the constraint 'finish CS4243 before CS2102' is impossible because CS4243 requires (YSC2232 or MA2001...) which are not completed, and even if taken, CS2102 has no prerequisite on CS4243. More critically, CS4243 prerequisites include MA1521 (completed), ST1131 (not completed), CS2030S (completed), CS2040S (completed), and MA1511/MA1512 (not completed). The student has not completed ST1131, MA1511, or MA1512, nor any of their alternatives (MA2001, YSC2232, etc.). Thus CS4243 cannot be taken. Since CS4243 is a 'must' course but cannot be taken due to missing prerequisites, no plan exists.
